description: Diff of the market since a time: tokens whose price moved by more than X %, tokens with a new first pool, new governance actions and large trades. Price moves cover at most the last 24 h (no older price snapshots), tokens below the liquidity floor are left out, and sections that could not be read are listed under `unavailable`. Also at /api/md/changes?since=.

minChangePct.description: Smallest absolute price change in percent to list a token (default 10).

minLiquidityAda.description: Leave out tokens with less pool liquidity than this many ADA (default 10,000).

minTradeAda.description: Smallest trade in ADA to count as large (default 100,000; at least 1,000 is used).

since.description: ISO 8601 time (2026-10-21T08:00:00Z), a date, or an age such as 90m, 6h or 2d (at most 30 days back; the diff itself covers at most the last 7 days).

name: what_changed
title: What changed since a time
